clips.title: The story
paras: The Problem With Prideclaws addresses the encroaching threat of wild prideclaw predators in the Shen'dar Highlands. As local settlements already grapple with bandits and cultists, culling the encroaching beasts protects vulnerable villagers while yielding useful pelts for the community.

The hills surrounding the Shen'dar Highlands are fraught with peril, pressed not only by roving bandits and unhinged cultists but also by an encroaching population of prideclaws. These fierce beasts have begun pressing inward toward the village perimeter, growing bolder as their territory expands and creating an imminent hazard for the local inhabitants.

To avert disaster before pets or children are snatched by the wandering predators, villagers have organized a culling effort. Taking down the prideclaws serves a dual purpose: it drives the predators back from the settlement borders while providing sturdy pelts that craftsmen can fashion into essential goods for the village.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: As if bandits and mad cultists weren't enough, the hills are thick with prideclaws as well right now. They are starting to encroach on the village borders and growing bolder by the day. It's only a matter of time before someone's pet or child is taken. It would be a mercy for us to cull their numbers now rather than after some tragedy occurs.
Bring me a dozen or so of their pelts. I can turn them into all sorts of goods that will be of aid to the village.

clips.title: Progress
paras: If you ask me, I think Prideclaws are actually kind of cute. From a safe distance... And while standing behind someone holding a sword, of course.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I didn't say it wouldn't be a dirty job, did I?
